resources.string:
Author: Group
Activity version: Version 1

Choose languages using the dropdowns. Drag the divider to adjust the panels, or double-tap it to reset. Use the bottom navigation to explore the app.

Tap Start Camera and allow camera access for a live preview. Stop Camera releases it. Switch Camera changes between front and rear when both are available. Leaving Home or backgrounding the app stops the camera; tap Start Camera again when you return. Rotation keeps an active session.

This version does not record or upload video. Sign recognition and speech features will be added in a later iteration.

ASL Translator
CP470 Term Project: An American Sign Language live translation app
